# Existing teaching materials: preserved source copies

These are **actual upstream teaching materials**, included unchanged where their licenses permit redistribution. The 13 Jupyter notebooks and one Marimo `.py` notebook are separate from the 79 original guided lessons. Original credits, outputs and incomplete student exercises remain as supplied; supporting datasets, media and packages may need the upstream environment.

| Folder | Included practicals | Assignment |
|---|---|---|
| [processing](processing/README.md) | Nipype BIDS input, workflow, preprocessing; Dartmouth current Marimo preprocessing | Trace real interfaces/graphs and connect each stage to PR lessons; execute a supervised source workflow |
| [design](design/README.md) | Poldrack DesignEfficiency and EfficiencyCorrelation; legacy DartBrains Resampling Statistics | Examine design-efficiency tradeoffs and resampling assumptions; complete source exercises with recorded environment |
| [data_science](data_science/README.md) | Neuromatch MSE fitting, MLE fitting, geometric view of data | Work through derivations/plots after DS least-squares, likelihood and basis/PCA lessons |
| [modeling](modeling/README.md) | BrainIAK RSA/ISC; Neuromatch CNN/HMM | Extend local mechanics to the longer models and real-data workflows |

**Execution status:** these source copies were retrieved, inspected and checked against SHA-256 provenance. Their downloads, external tools, and incomplete exercise cells were **not executed as part of our course validation**. Do not run them all automatically. Open the linked hosted curriculum, inspect its dependencies/data instructions, and make a working copy in your own study folder. Record actual completion and any repairs separately; do not overwrite the preserved originals.

The current DartBrains chapter uses **Marimo**, whereas the dated design-source snapshot uses **Jupyter**. Preserving both demonstrates their true formats; the current chapter has not been falsely relabeled an `.ipynb`.

Files do not inherit the surrounding repository's license. See [third-party notices](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) and the license/provenance files in each directory. Berkeley Data 8, MIT OCW, FSL and FreeSurfer readings are linked to the original sites; this repository does not mirror their course text, figures or datasets.
